title: BGC Argo 1902594 · cycle 34

salinity.label: Practical salinity
salinity.definition: Practical salinity, PSS-78; not absolute salinity

oxygen.label: Dissolved oxygen
oxygen.definition: Dissolved oxygen per mass of sea water

chlorophyll.label: Chlorophyll a
chlorophyll.definition: Chlorophyll-a concentration reported by the source

depth_method: -gsw.z_from_p(sea pressure in dbar, sample latitude), GSW 3.6.20; dynamic height and surface geopotential default to zero. Source order is retained.
qc_policy: Per-variable QC: Argo 1/2; QARTOD 1 only; WOCE 2 only; documented CSV 1/2. Depth requires eligible pressure and position/time. Raw BGC R mode is inspect-only. Missing adjusted values never fall back to raw.
warnings: Historical observations; selecting a profile does not establish a model match.
BGC S-files align sensor sampling levels at the source. BGC variables can have different data modes; this is not a simulated profile.
This March 2024 profile is inside the Bay of Bengal model rectangle, but outside its January 2024 time coverage. It is not a simultaneous model comparison.

CHLA_ADJUSTED is the provider-derived chlorophyll estimate from fluorescence. It is not CHLA_FLUORESCENCE or a chlorophyll model field. Source calibration details are retained; source reprocessing can change later downloads.

PRES.long_name: Sea water pressure, equals 0 at sea-level

SCIENTIFIC_CALIB_COMMENT: DOXY_ADJUSTED is computed from an adjustment of in water PSAT or PPOX float data at surface by comparison to woaPSAT climatology or WOA PPOX in using woaPSAT and floatTEMP and PSAL at 1 atm, DOXY_ADJUSTED_ERROR is computed from a PPOX_ERROR of 10 mbar

CHLA real time adjustment (specified in http://dx.doi.org/10.13155/35385 and computed with MLD_LIMIT = 0.03, and following recommendations of Roesler et al., 2017 (https://doi.org/10.1002/lom3.10185))
CHLA_FLUORESCENCE real time adjustment (specified in http://dx.doi.org/10.13155/35385 and computed with MLD_LIMIT = 0.03)
BBP700_ADJUSTED is being filled with BBP700 directly in real time. Adjustment method may be enhanced in the future. RTQC_APPLIED 11110 RTQC_FAILED 00000

CHLA real time adjustment (specified in http://dx.doi.org/10.13155/35385 and computed with MLD_LIMIT = 0.03, and following recommendations of Sauzede et al., 2025 (https://doi.org/10.17882/105732)). PHYSIO_RATIO extracted from the LUT.
CHLA_FLUORESCENCE real time adjustment (specified in http://dx.doi.org/10.13155/35385 and computed with MLD_LIMIT = 0.03)
SCIENTIFIC_CALIB_EQUATION: CHLA_ADJUSTED = CHLA_NPQ for PRES in [0,ZMaxFluo], CHLA_ADJUSTED = ((FLUORESCENCE_CHLA-MEDIAN(PRELIM_DARK_CHLA))*SCALE_CHLA)/2 otherwise
CHLA_ADJUSTED = CHLA_NPQ for PRES in [0,ZMaxFluo], CHLA_ADJUSTED = ((FLUORESCENCE_CHLA-MEDIAN(PRELIM_DARK_CHLA))*SCALE_CHLA)/PHYSIO_RATIO otherwise
